screens.title: Detail Tugas & Checklist AI
screens.purpose: Provide task inspection, explicit source requirements, and an interactive AI step-by-step checklist with progress tracking and editing.
screens.stitchPromptBrief: A modern, high-craft light mode task detail interface for Indonesian college students. Clean slate-50 background with crisp white cards and slate-200 hairline borders. Header displays task title, course badge, and deadline info. Below is a section for 'Ketentuan dari pengumuman' followed by a distinct 'Langkah Pengerjaan (Saran AI)' card. The AI checklist includes a fractional completion counter (e.g. '3 dari 5 selesai'), animated progress bar, checklist items with custom rounded checkboxes and hover-visible edit triggers, an active inline editing mode, a friendly regenerate button with warning tooltip, and clear empty, loading skeleton, and error retry states. Academic productivity aesthetic with deep slate text and purposeful indigo-blue accent.
